description.ch-1: Jane is a young woman with great skills in cartography and whose profound desire is freedom with her friends.
description.ch-35: Jane is a young woman with great skills in cartography and whose profound desire is freedom with her friends. She is Dahlia's partner.

description.ch-1: Jane's best friend despite being hot-headed, Maha is an experienced warrior and, above all, extremely loyal.

description.ch-21: Dahlia is an open-minded and curious individual, always eager to explore the world around her. Freedom and friendship are the core values that guide her.
description.ch-35: Dahlia is an open-minded and curious individual, always eager to explore the world around her. Freedom and friendship are the core values that guide her. She is Jane's partner.

description.ch-21: Both calm and thoughtful, Sofia is an emotionally intelligent person whom her friends can rely on.
Vincent is, next to Jane, the youngest member of the pack. Despite his age, he is smart and a fast learner, and skillful in art.
Despite his height and experience in combat, Alan is a gentle man. He is Ahn's partner.
Ahn is just as energetic and confident as she is compassionate and inclusive. She is Alan's partner.
Ivan is a wise and experienced individual. His skills in medecine and will to help others make him a trustful person to both outsiders and pack members.
Although Sean appears as a playful and curious man, he can show maturity and compassion when it matters most.
Yousra is a strong and fierce person, whose protectiveness towards her friends can lead to aggression.
Calm and compassionate, Justine has a strong sense of justice.
Junseo is quick with his jokes, although shy with those outside of his close circle.
Despite his strength, Victor is a calm and reserved person that likes stability.

description.ch-3: Judy is her clan's primary raid intermediate, a role she has earned thanks to her tactiful mind, her ability to recognize others' strengths, and her obedience. Outside of her duties, she is an extroverted girl with a bubbly personality.
Frederick is the Blue's 'low-bridge' and the closest leader to the clan's life. His charismatic personality has earned him Jane's friendship.
description.ch-12: Frederick is the Blue's 'low-bridge' and the closest leader to the clan's life. His charismatic personality has earned him Jane's friendship. Yet, despite his love for the clan, his failed attempt to escape years ago has bound him to the Blue forever.

description.ch-3: George is a young boy who joined the raid team early. Despite his newcomer's fears, he shows extreme adaptability and willingness to learn from the clan.
As one of the Blue's most skillful hunters, Ahmed is an energetic boy that cares a lot for his friends.

description.ch-15: Clémence is a gatherer living in the French village. She is carefree and curious, and loves to make others smile. She welcomed Jane into her home.
